column1: 06.  An individual or a Body, Organizations or Institution should as far as possible, refrain from making more than three

column2: nominations in respect of the same Mediation Board Area. However, this limitation will not apply to the present Chairman
of the Panel of Mediators and to the District Secretaries, and Divisional Secretaries.
All nominations should be forwarded to reach the Secretary, Mediation Boards Commission, Ministry of Justice
Building, 4th Floor, No. 19, Sri Sangaraja Mawatha, Colombo 10, Before 31st December 2025.
The Mediation Boards Commission will, based on the basic qualifications to be checked at interview, select eligible
candidates to be offered a preliminary training on Mediation skills and methods.
Final decision in connection with any matter which is not being prevailed by the regulation stipulated in this notice is
the decision made by Mediation Boards Commission at any time.
